name: io.github.iowarp/terrain-mcp
title: CLIO Terrain
description: MCP server for terrain analysis: DEM slope/aspect/suitability and point-cloud reading/gridding

tools.name: dem_terrain
tools.description: Analyze a Digital Elevation Model grid for elevation, slope, aspect, and site suitability. Accepts CSV numeric grids, NPY, and NPZ (with a 'dem' array); GeoTIFF requires the optional rasterio extra. Returns grid shape, summary statistics, suitability counts, and representative suitable cells.

tools.name: pointcloud_read
tools.description: Read an x/y/z point cloud and grid it into a DEM-like surface by averaging z per cell. Accepts CSV with x,y,z columns, NPY, and NPZ; LAS/LAZ requires the optional laspy extra. Optionally writes the gridded surface to a CSV DEM for downstream dem_terrain analysis. Returns point/grid stats and bounds.

resources.name: terrain_capabilities
resources.description: Supported input formats, tools, and safety limits for terrain analysis.

prompts.name: terrain_suitability_workflow
prompts.description: Guided workflow for assessing site suitability from terrain data.
